system.description:
You collect and build illusionary chakra, attempting to black out the thoughts of your targets, making it difficult for them to form coherent or even manageable thoughts.

Select one creature you are aware of, that can hear you within range, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist most of this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature is Confused until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures begins to suffer mental black outs. At the beginning of each of their turns, all creatures in the turn initiative, is treated as a hostile creature for them, and they cannot exclude creatures in the effect area of a jutsu or features effects. At the end of each of their turns, they remake their saving throw, ending this jutsu’s effect on them on a success.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they no longer remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
